11.t: Working with data: test tube pitch
q: What was the frequency for a 12 cm air column?
Longer air column, lower frequency (lower pitch).
One point does not fit the pattern. Identify it and suggest a reason.
The 8 cm point (870 Hz) is lower than the trend: perhaps the student blew differently or misread the app.
Suggest how to make the data more reliable and what to keep the same.
Repeat each length and take a mean; keep the same tube diameter, blowing angle and distance to the microphone.
